name: Daily Sales Data Sync

metrics.title: Latest Day Volume
metrics.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(shipment_quantity),0) AS value FROM erp_product_sales_details WHERE shipment_date = (SELECT MAX(shipment_date) FROM erp_product_sales_details) AND (:dim_date IS NULL OR shipment_date >= :dim_date)

metrics.title: Latest Day Order Lines
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM erp_product_sales_details WHERE shipment_date = (SELECT MAX(shipment_date) FROM erp_product_sales_details) AND (:dim_date IS NULL OR shipment_date >= :dim_date)

metrics.title: Active Customers
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT partner_name) AS value FROM erp_product_sales_details WHERE shipment_date = (SELECT MAX(shipment_date) FROM erp_product_sales_details) AND (:dim_date IS NULL OR shipment_date >= :dim_date)

metrics.title: Daily Shipment Volume
metrics.sql: SELECT shipment_date AS label, COALESCE(SUM(shipment_quantity),0) AS value FROM erp_product_sales_details WHERE shipment_date >= DATE_SUB((SELECT MAX(shipment_date) FROM erp_product_sales_details), INTERVAL 14 DAY) AND (:dim_date IS NULL OR shipment_date >= :dim_date) GROUP BY shipment_date ORDER BY shipment_date

metrics.title: Daily Order-Line Activity
metrics.sql: SELECT shipment_date AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM erp_product_sales_details WHERE shipment_date >= DATE_SUB((SELECT MAX(shipment_date) FROM erp_product_sales_details), INTERVAL 14 DAY) AND (:dim_date IS NULL OR shipment_date >= :dim_date) GROUP BY shipment_date ORDER BY shipment_date

metrics.title: Customer Share (Latest Day)
metrics.sql: SELECT partner_name AS label, COALESCE(SUM(shipment_quantity),0) AS value FROM erp_product_sales_details WHERE shipment_date = (SELECT MAX(shipment_date) FROM erp_product_sales_details) AND (:dim_date IS NULL OR shipment_date >= :dim_date) GROUP BY partner_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 6

metrics.title: Recent Shipment Days
metrics.sql: SELECT shipment_date AS 'Shipment Date', COUNT(*) AS 'Order Lines', COALESCE(SUM(shipment_quantity),0) AS 'Volume (t)', COUNT(DISTINCT partner_name) AS 'Customers' FROM erp_product_sales_details WHERE shipment_date >= DATE_SUB((SELECT MAX(shipment_date) FROM erp_product_sales_details), INTERVAL 14 DAY) AND (:dim_date IS NULL OR shipment_date >= :dim_date) GROUP BY shipment_date ORDER BY shipment_date DESC

insights.body: 3,957.5 t shipped on the most recent day versus 13,299.4 t the day before — a sharp single-day contraction consistent with a quiet year-end order book.
insights.title: Latest volume −70% vs prior day

insights.body: 客户C alone carried ~79% of latest-day volume (3,131 t of 3,958 t), leaving the book exposed to single-account swings.
insights.title: Customer concentration high

insights.body: Latest day sits ~67% under the trailing 8-day average (~11,852 t), flagging an anomaly worth watching in the next sync.
insights.title: Volume below 8-day norm

description: Real-time view of ERP sales sync activity: daily shipment volume, order-line activity, customer concentration, and anomaly flags across recent shipment windows.
